provenance.purpose: Prospective matched observable-map architecture and estimator comparison; L4 first, then L3; five paired seeds per four-arm panel.
provenance.reference: Reference Paper.pdf Appendix C.1 and supplied ANN/network.py define the local PaperMLP; the CNN and this controlled training policy are our adaptations.
provenance.controls: Fresh map-MLP and CNN models receive the same Hamiltonian batches and epoch opportunities. Old edge-batched MLPs are historical context, not the matched architecture control.
provenance.evaluation: Hamiltonian-grouped validation only. Own-view MSE selects strict best weights; crossed f/g/exact predictions and reference-sign-assisted D5 are post-selection diagnostics. No final-test or spin-record access.
provenance.scope: Known-field simulation; raw unclipped magnitudes; exact inputs never train or select. Larger matched lattices and snapshot CNNs remain deferred. Long runs are user launched.
